args.prompt: Reuse EXACTLY the same character as in the reference images (a chibi cat-unicorn: big round white head, two pointy cat ears with pink inner ears, golden spiral horn centered on top, closed happy eyes as upside-down U arcs, pink blush stripes, tiny dark nose and cat 'w' smile, small white bean body, thin stick arms and thin stick legs, bright pink mane behind the head and a big fluffy bright pink tail). Same proportions, same colors, same pixel size in every frame. Draw exactly 8 frames in ONE horizontal row, equally spaced, every frame the same size, all frames standing on the same invisible ground line, side view facing right unless stated, plenty of empty space between frames so no frame touches another. The character is about 40 percent of the image height. SPEED animation, 8 frames: (1)-(4) FAST RUN CYCLE: strong forward lean of about 15 degrees, legs stretched in a wide stride, arms swept back, mane and tail streaming straight behind, EYES OPEN wide and determined with a big open smile and small white eye highlights, four different cycle poses; (5)-(6) STOMP bounce: legs pushing down on the ground, body squashed then stretched, happy laughing open mouth, closed eyes; (7)-(8) FAST FALL cannonball: body curled into a tight ball falling down, eyes squeezed shut, mane and tail pointing straight up. 16-bit Super Nintendo style pixel art, chunky hard square pixels, a clean 1-pixel dark plum outline, flat cel shading with one highlight and one shadow tone, light from the top left, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no blur, no text, no labels, no watermark. Solid flat cyan background, nothing else.
